save_obj_with_surface_textures: save a mesh to OBJ format with surface textures, MTL material file, and a PNG texture atlas
save_obj_with_vertex_colors: save a mesh to OBJ format with per-vertex RGB colors instead of surface textures
save_obj_plain_mesh: save a plain mesh to OBJ format with vertices and faces but no textures or colors
create_texture_image_from_faces: create a texture atlas image and UV coordinates from per-face texture colors for a mesh
save_voxel_as_obj: save a 3D voxel grid as an OBJ file by converting active voxels to vertices
